# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 with span-based perf work** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed code. A batch of performance PRs move color conversion, premultiply math, tag parsing and HarfBuzzSharp buffer handling into managed span-based code, cutting allocations and native round-trips. WASM builds move to Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new exnref exception handling model, and a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData is fixed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled engine advances to m151, folding in the upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged throughout the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Span-based hex color parsing** — SKColor gains ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads alongside an optimized hex-parsing path. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks** — Fixes a native resource leak when decoding a bounded subset of encoded image data. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to correct a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and premultiply math ported to managed C#** — SKColor -> SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, removing the `unsafe` modifier from GRContextOptions along the way. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))
- **Allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper hot paths** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses a pooled UTF-8 encode, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse drop their per-call char[4] allocations, and SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **WASM moves to Emscripten 5.0.6 with exnref exception handling** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries land for .NET 11, built with the new exnref exception-handling model, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch regressions early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))
- **Skia submodule drops the WASM build-flag redefinition** — Bumps the Skia submodule to remove an unnecessary SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition in the native build. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with a pooled UTF-8 encode and removes the per-call char[4] allocation from Tag.Parse.
